entities.summary: Patricia Kihoro (b. 1986-01-21, Nairobi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nairobi and Kenya. Known in the fields of kenya, composers & musicians, africa.
